recommendedActions: Prepare for immediate synchronized cardioversion if hemodynamic stability deteriorates (patient is currently stable, but status can change rapidly).
Administer intravenous amiodarone or procainamide per ACLS guidelines for stable monomorphic VT.
Obtain 12-lead ECG for definitive rhythm confirmation and ischemia screen.
Continue continuous cardiac and hemodynamic monitoring.
Consult Electrophysiology (EP) for urgent evaluation regarding ICD implantation given LVEF 35% and VT episode.
